product_overview: Show Command Center is a single-user web app that consolidates trade-show schedules, deadlines, tasks, and promotional e-blasts into a single command center so coordinators can see what is due and act without context-switching.
core_goals: Quickly identify the next upcoming show and days until move-in
Create and manage shows with key deadlines and service tags
Manage per-show tasks, e-blasts, and related links from a single command center
See all scheduled items on a monthly calendar and export events as .ics
Track and manage office-wide tasks and maintain quick notes (sticky notes) locally

features.name: Dashboard / Show List
features.description: View active and archived shows, see the next upcoming show with a countdown, sort the list, and open a show's command center.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See 'Next Up' banner with days-until-move-in countdown -> View list of active shows rendered on the page
Navigate to / -> Select sort order from dropdown (date ascending, date descending, name, overdue) -> Observe show list reorder according to selection
Navigate to / -> Expand archived shows section -> View archived shows -> Collapse archived shows section
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> See show metadata and progress

features.name: Add New Show
features.description: Open a dialog to create a new show with required name and move-in date, optional deadlines and venue, and selectable service tags; successful creation navigates to the new show's detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Add Show button to open the create dialog -> Fill in Show Name -> Fill in Move-in Date -> Optionally set venue, advance warehouse date, discount deadline, online order deadline, show start, and dismantle date -> Check one or more service tag checkboxes -> Click Create Show to submit -> See navigation to the new show's detail page
Navigate to / -> Click Add Show button to open the create dialog -> Leave Show Name or Move-in Date empty -> Click Create Show to submit -> See validation error and dialog remains open

features.name: Show Detail / Command Center
features.description: Centralized view for a specific show presenting metadata, key deadlines, tags, an urgency badge, and a combined progress bar with tabs to manage tasks, e-blasts, and links; supports editing and deleting the show.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> View show metadata card with move-in date, venue, key deadlines, tags, and urgency badge -> See overall progress bar reflecting tasks and e-blasts completion
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click edit (pencil) icon to open Edit Show dialog -> Update fields -> Save changes -> See updated metadata reflected
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click trash icon to delete the show -> Confirm deletion -> See the show removed from the dashboard

features.name: Tasks Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: Manage show-specific tasks: view, add custom tasks, add preset tasks, toggle completion, adjust dates, and delete tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Tasks tab to manage show tasks -> View list of tasks with completion status and due dates

Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Tasks tab -> Click Add Task to create a custom task -> Fill in task title and optional due date -> Submit the new task -> See the new task appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Tasks tab -> Click a preset task button to add a predefined task -> See the preset task added to the list
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Tasks tab -> Toggle a task completion checkbox -> See the task marked complete and progress update
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Tasks tab -> Click trash icon on a task -> Confirm deletion -> See the task removed from the list

features.name: E-Blasts Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: Schedule and track e-blasts per show: view scheduled e-blasts, add presets or all presets at once, create custom e-blasts, toggle sent status, and delete entries.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> View list of e-blasts with sent status and scheduled dates
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> Click a preset e-blast button to add a scheduled e-blast -> See the new e-blast appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> Click Add All button to add all preset e-blasts -> See all preset e-blasts added to the list

Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> Create a custom e-blast by filling required fields -> Submit the e-blast -> See the custom e-blast appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> Toggle an e-blast sent checkbox -> See the e-blast marked as sent
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click E-Blasts tab -> Click trash icon on an e-blast -> Confirm deletion -> See the e-blast removed

features.name: Links Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: Attach, view, open, and delete hyperlinks related to a show for quick access to external resources.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Links tab -> View list of links with labels and URLs

Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Links tab -> Click Add Link to create a new link entry -> Fill in label and URL -> Submit the new link -> See the link appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Links tab -> Click a link in the list -> Open the link in a new browser tab
Navigate to / -> Click a show card to open its detail page -> Click Links tab -> Click trash icon on a link -> Confirm deletion -> See the link removed

features.name: Calendar View
features.description: Monthly calendar showing move-ins, tasks, e-blasts, and office tasks with month navigation, per-show filtering, day detail panel, office task toggles, and .ics export.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> See monthly calendar grid with current month events
Navigate to /calendar -> Click next month arrow -> See calendar update to the next month -> Click previous month arrow -> See calendar update to the previous month
Navigate to /calendar -> Use show filter dropdown to select a specific show -> See calendar events filtered to that show
Navigate to /calendar -> Click a day cell in the month grid -> See detailed event list for that day appear in the side panel
Navigate to /calendar -> Click a day cell to open the side panel -> Toggle an office task completion directly from the side panel -> See the task marked complete
Navigate to /calendar -> Click Export .ics -> Download the calendar .ics file

features.name: Office Tasks
features.description: Manage office-wide tasks with create/edit/delete, filters for priority/status/category, sorting, search, and a sticky-notes sidebar (sticky notes are stored in localStorage and not persisted to the backend).
user_flows: Navigate to /office-tasks -> View active and completed office tasks rendered on the page

Navigate to /office-tasks -> Click New Task button to open create dialog -> Fill in title, priority, status, due date, category, and notes -> Submit to create task -> See the new task appear in the list
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Toggle a task completion checkbox -> See the task move to completed state or update its status
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Click pencil icon on a task to edit -> Update fields -> Save changes -> See the updated task details reflected
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Click trash icon on a task -> Confirm deletion -> See the task removed from the list
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Use filters for status, priority, and category in combination -> See the task list update to match filter criteria
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Use search to find tasks by title -> See filtered results
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Sort the list by date created, due date, or priority -> See list reorder accordingly
Navigate to /office-tasks -> Expand completed tasks section -> View completed tasks -> Collapse completed tasks section

Navigate to /office-tasks -> Interact with sticky-notes sidebar to add a note -> Edit a sticky note -> Recolor a sticky note -> Delete a sticky note -> See sticky notes change locally (stored in browser localStorage)

tech_stack.other: wouter (routing), TanStack React Query, react-hook-form, zod, date-fns, framer-motion, next-themes

routes.description: Dashboard listing active and archived shows with sort options and a "Next Up" banner
Monthly calendar view showing move-in dates, tasks, e-blasts, and office task events with .ics export
Office task manager with create/edit/delete, priority/status/category filters, and a sticky-notes sidebar
Show detail page with metadata card, progress bar, and tabs for Tasks, E-Blasts, and Links

features.name: Dashboard / Show List
features.description: View all active and archived shows sorted by date, name, or overdue count; highlights the next upcoming show
user_interactions: View "Next Up" banner with days-until-move-in countdown
Select sort order from dropdown (date asc/desc, name, overdue)
Click a show card to navigate to its detail page
Expand/collapse the Archived Shows section

features.name: Add New Show
features.description: Open a dialog to create a new show with name, dates, venue, and tag checkboxes; navigates to the new show on success
user_interactions: Click "Add Show" button to open dialog
Fill in Show Name (required) and Move-in Date (required)
Optionally set venue, advance warehouse date, discount deadline, online order deadline, show start, and dismantle date
Check one or more tag checkboxes (FM, e-Blasts, ID Signs, etc.)
Click "Create Show" to submit
See error toast on failure

features.name: Show Detail / Command Center
features.description: View and manage all details for a specific show including metadata, progress, tasks, e-blasts, and links
user_interactions: View show metadata card (move-in date, venue, key deadlines, tags, urgency badge)
See overall progress bar (tasks + e-blasts completed)
Click Tasks tab to manage show tasks
Click E-Blasts tab to manage e-blast schedule
Click Links tab to manage show links
Click edit (pencil) icon to open Edit Show dialog
Click trash icon and confirm to delete the show

features.name: Tasks Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: View, create, complete, and delete show-specific tasks with preset and custom options
user_interactions: View list of tasks with completion status and due dates
Toggle task completion checkbox
Click "Add Task" to create a custom task
Use preset task buttons to add predefined tasks
Delete a task with the trash icon
Adjust task completion date

features.name: E-Blasts Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: View, create, complete, and delete e-blast entries with preset schedule options and an "Add All" button
user_interactions: View list of e-blasts with sent status and scheduled dates
Toggle e-blast sent checkbox
Click preset e-blast buttons to add scheduled e-blasts
Click "Add All" button to add all presets at once
Create a custom e-blast
Delete an e-blast
Adjust e-blast sent date

features.name: Links Tab (Show Detail)
features.description: View, create, and delete hyperlinks associated with a show
user_interactions: View list of links with labels and URLs
Click "Add Link" to create a new link entry
Click a link to open it in a new tab
Delete a link with the trash icon

features.name: Calendar View
features.description: Monthly calendar showing all scheduled events (move-ins, tasks, e-blasts, office tasks) with per-show filtering and .ics export
user_interactions: Navigate months with previous/next arrow buttons
Filter calendar by a specific show using the dropdown
Click a day cell to see detailed event list in the side panel
Toggle office task completion directly from the side panel
Click "Export .ics" to download a calendar file

features.name: Office Tasks
features.description: Standalone task manager for office-wide (non-show) tasks with filtering, sorting, priority/status/category management
user_interactions: View active and completed office tasks
Click "New Task" button to open create dialog
Fill in title, priority, status, due date, category, and notes
Toggle task completion via checkbox
Edit task by clicking the pencil icon
Delete task with trash icon and confirmation dialog
Filter by status, priority, or category using dropdowns
Search tasks by title
Sort by date created, due date, or priority
Expand/collapse completed tasks section
Add, edit, recolor, and delete sticky notes in the side panel

known_limitations.issue: Sticky notes (office-tasks page sidebar) are stored in localStorage only — not persisted to the backend
known_limitations.impact: Notes are lost if the user clears browser storage or switches browsers/devices
